authorization_scope: Root authorizes preparation only of one generic instruction clarification. Actual six-case generation requires separate independent native-contract review and root authorization.

baseline.result: 5acceptable/1major; sole material defect is personal-name localization

adapter.only_followup_source_change: Append one generic name-preservation clarification to existing translation system message.
adapter.added_instruction: Preserve personal names with faithful transliteration when changing scripts. Do not translate or localize personal names into culturally equivalent names.

storage.allocation_policy: One original payload in own content-addressed cache; partial renamed in place after hash verification. Native import must reuse its inode/allocation; no second full weight copy.

native_setup.import_system: No publisher persona is imported; original application system/user messages are explicit. Native fixed date/header framing is observed and bound.
checks_before_generation: Read and bind actual selected Q4 GGUF header, complete embedded tokenizer/merges/special IDs and template; compare with pinned publisher references.
Verify original model file and imported descriptors/config/parameters/stops with exact bytes and hashes, no draft/projector/system persona.
Verify actual owned native text runner uses pinned file, context4096 and four CPU threads; all loads/preflights externally measured.
Render every exact complete original application request through native runtime; bind effective formatting including BOS/date/stops with no source loss or generated answer.
Count full actual native prompt including required special tokens and allow full2048 response plus end reserve within4096; no cropping.
Freeze preparation report and helper/runner identities, then obtain independent native contract review before generation.
native_setup.import_policy: Reuse exact verified baseline native cache; no create/import mutation.

request_profile.messages_schema_and_source: Unchanged current production translation; exact six expected requests are frozen.
request_profile.retention: Existing bounded production cleanup; explicit unload and empty resident-model list after each case.

evaluation.semantic_rule: All original case-specific criteria and unchanged global actor/name/number/unit/relationship/negation/uncertainty/action/condition/chronology/completeness rule. Grade final raw meanings separately from successful app acceptance.
evaluation.guard_rejection: Keep full returned raw JSON/final content even when the current app guard rejects; operational rejection is a failed case and cannot be counted as success.

limits.scope: Externally sampled concurrent supervisor/worker/owned daemon/native process tree, including loading. PSS recorded. Sampling may miss transients; not a kernel cap or full-app/whole-machine approval.

stop_rules: Stop and preserve evidence on first storage/hash/import/tokenizer/template/protocol/structure/script-guard/execution/resource/time/measurement/cleanup failure; no retry or crop.
Completed normal responses that require semantic review retain all errors; no tuning between the originally fixed six cases.
No model or quantization sweep, hints, glossary, repairs, altered prompt/sampling/context/output budget, extra case, unusedv3, summary, whole-app test or production switch.
scope_limits: Exactly six original exposed development cases once if separately authorized; no retries or tuning between cases.
A six-case pass permits no automatic next stage or promotion; all meaning/protocol/resource gates remain.
No v2/v3, summary, whole-app or production change in this stage.

setup_revision.only_behavior_change: Compare complete parsed parameter mapping rather than arbitrary /api/show map line order; reject missing/unexpected/duplicate singleton fields and preserve stop list order. New private log paths preserve the failed attempt.
